description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Cost acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Cost rejection"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_ComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairCost" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairCost" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRepairCost" messageRef="Message_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRepairCost" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Are the costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send cost acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerAccepts" name="Costs accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send cost rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerRejects" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRepairCost" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${costsAcceptable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_AcceptEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_CustomerAccepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not costsAcceptable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_RejectHome" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_RejectEnd" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_CustomerRejects"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComputerReceived" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRepairCost" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForDecision" name="Wait for customer decision"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive cost acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive cost rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairDeclined" name="Repair declined"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Perform both repair activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Both activities tested"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialError" name="Error detected?" default="Flow_Initial_NoError"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChooseAdditionalRepair" name="Choose another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAdditionalHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAdditionalSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Repair activity completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalError" name="Error detected?" default="Flow_Additional_NoError"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_ComputerReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendRepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairCost" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Acceptance" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_RepairDeclined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept_Split" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestHardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSoftware_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_InitialError" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InitialError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Initial_Error" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="Gateway_ChooseAdditionalRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Initial_NoError" name="No error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_AdditionalHardware" sourceRef="Gateway_ChooseAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_AdditionalSoftware" sourceRef="Gateway_ChooseAdditionalRepair" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalHardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardware" targetRef="Task_TestAdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalSoftware_Test" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestAdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestAdditionalHardware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestAdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestAdditionalSoftware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestAdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalMerge_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Error" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="Gateway_ChooseAdditionalRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_NoError" name="No error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
